subtasks.title: Project management sidebar (create/edit/delete + rename)
subtasks.prompt:
Implement the entire feature described in PLAN.md: a collapsible, auto-hiding Projects sidebar on the right of the kanban board that lets the user add, rename, edit branch-naming, and delete projects. This does not decompose into parallel slices — the sidebar imports both the new client `api.renameProject` and the new `PROJECTS_PANEL_COLLAPSED_KEY`, and App.tsx imports the sidebar, so build it as one unit in this order. Do exactly the nine file changes enumerated in PLAN.md's "Changes" and "Files touched" sections, using the concrete code snippets given there: 1. `src/bun/db.ts` — add `projects.rename(path, name)` after `setBranchConfig`, before `delete` (verbatim snippet in PLAN.md §1). No migration (column exists). 2. `src/bun/server.ts` — add a `PATCH` sibling inside the existing `"/projects"` route object (§2). Mirror the existing POST/DELETE style: `authed`, `corsHeaders(req)`, `json(...)`. `projects` is already imported. 3. `src/mainview/lib/api.ts` — add `renameProject` after `deleteProject` (§3). 4. `src/mainview/lib/panel-collapse.ts` — export `PROJECTS_PANEL_COLLAPSED_KEY = "agetor:projectsPanelCollapsed"` next to `NEW_TASK_PANEL_COLLAPSED_KEY` (§4). 5. NEW `src/mainview/components/kanban/ProjectsSidebar.tsx` — mirror `NewTaskForm.tsx`'s collapse structure but with the border on the LEFT (`border-l`), toggle at `-left-2.5`, `w-72` expanded / `w-11` collapsed rail, `transition-[width] duration-200`. Follow §5 exactly for props (`projects: Project[]`, `onChanged: () => void`), state (`collapsed` lazy-init from `readCollapsed(PROJECTS_PANEL_COLLAPSED_KEY)` + `useEffect` → `writeCollapsed`; `renamingPath`/`renameText`; `branchProjectPath`; `busy`), the expanded body (Add via `api.pickProject()`, scrollable project list with inline rename on Enter/blur/Escape, path shown truncated with `title`, Branch-naming button opening the shared `BranchNamingDialog`, Delete via `useConfirm({ variant: "destructive" })` then `api.deleteProject`, empty state), the collapsed vertical-label rail, and the single shared `BranchNamingDialog` at the bottom (exact JSX in §5). Copy the 3-line `basename` helper from `ProjectPicker.tsx`. Import the `Project` type via the RELATIVE path `../../../shared/types.ts` (matching ProjectPicker), NOT the `@/` alias. Reuse `BranchNamingDialog` from `src/mainview/components/settings/BranchNamingDialog.tsx` as-is — do not duplicate branch-config UI. 6. `src/mainview/App.tsx` — import `ProjectsSidebar` near the other kanban imports; mount it inside `
` immediately AFTER `` and before that row's closing `
`, with `projects={projects}` and `onChanged={() => { void api.listProjects().then(setProjects).catch(() => {}); }}` (§6). `projects`/`setProjects` already exist. Tests (gate tests, deterministic, same commit — required, no exceptions): - NEW `src/bun/projects-crud-endpoint.test.ts` — model on `project-settings-endpoint.test.ts`; temp `AGETOR_DATA_DIR`, `AGETOR_API_PORT=4402` (distinct from 4401), Bearer auth. Cover every case in PLAN.md §A (POST valid/relative/nonexistent, PATCH rename/empty-name/unregistered, DELETE). - NEW `src/bun/projects-db.test.ts` — temp `AGETOR_DATA_DIR`, import `projects` from `./db.ts`; cover §B (upsert→rename changes name and leaves branchConfig untouched; rename unknown path → null; upsert re-call keeps original name). - EXTEND `src/mainview/lib/panel-collapse.test.ts` — add §C (key is non-empty string, distinct from `NEW_TASK_PANEL_COLLAPSED_KEY`, round-trips independently through `writeCollapsed`/`readCollapsed` with a fakeStorage). No evals — PLAN.md §Evals states this is pure deterministic CRUD + UI chrome with no latent-space component; the gate tests are the full verification surface. Verification before declaring done: `bun run typecheck` green (watch the `Project` import path — relative, not `@/`); `bun test src/bun/projects-crud-endpoint.test.ts src/bun/projects-db.test.ts` green; `bun test src/mainview/lib/panel-collapse.test.ts` green. Read PLAN.md in full before starting — every snippet and constraint you need is there.
